patch.value: Add Beads JSONL exporter + id/dependency round-trip

value.author: codex
value.text: Design: added registerExporter("beads") -> pm beads export (stdout or --output), kept registerImporter("beads") -> pm beads import. registerItemFields([bead_id]) (capability schema; manifest already lists commands/schema/importers, importers covers the exporter). Original Beads id persisted via [bead_id: <id>] marker in description (pm create has no generic custom-field setter for standalone extensions) and re-emitted on export. Beads dependencies/blocked_by edges mapped to pm blocked_by deps via two-pass import (create all, then update --dep id=<pmId>,kind=blocked_by); export translates pm ids back to bead ids. Flags: --preserve-ids default on (--no-preserve-ids to disable), --output/-o for export, plus existing --dry-run/--type/--priority/--tags. Renamed legacy rich-help commands to beads-import/beads-export to avoid command_handler_collision with the importer/exporter-auto-created commands. Verification: npm run build clean, npx tsc --noEmit clean, npm test 9/9 pass. Functional: pm init+install, extension doctor active 0 failures 0 collisions; imported 3-record JSONL with ids+2 dep edges, exported back, asserted all ids+deps survived round-trip; --no-preserve-ids emits pm-* ids.

patch.value: Exporter + schema field + id/dependency round-trip shipped and verified (build/tsc/test/functional all green).
